# Critical Reasoning

## Procedure
Check source quality, recency, selection bias, survivorship bias, confounding, opportunity cost and falsifiability. Offer strongest counterargument.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
